refuted.description: true if the finding does not hold up

citedLineMatches.description: true if the cited file:line actually contains what the finding claims

reachable.description: true if the path is reachable in production (not test/example-only)

premiseSupported.description: true if the load-bearing premise is either self-contained at the cited line or actually shown by the code at whereChecked; false if it is an off-site claim with no evidence that checks out

behaviourIntended.description: true when the code (a doc comment, a name, a test) or the PR states that the flagged behaviour is intended; false otherwise. It never refutes the finding: it only stops the intent-unmet harm level

harmSupported.description: true only if the code shows a listed harm (effect, who, recovery) as stated at a level that holds; behaviour stated as intended is not intent-unmet

confirmedHarmLevel.description: the worst listed level that holds; "none" when no listed level holds or none is listed — a vote naming "none" confirms no level
